VCM Series Dash-Mounted Cruise Control Switch




Upgrade your cockpit with the HND-9 dash-mounted cruise control switch—where precision engineering meets standout style. Built to integrate flawlessly with Dakota Digital’s VCM Series cruise control systems, this compact powerhouse delivers effortless control right at your fingertips.

CNC-machined from premium aluminum, the HND-9’s sleek 2.05” x 1.45” profile is small enough to tuck neatly into subtle locations—yet bold enough to deserve center stage. Whether you hide it or highlight it, this switch adds a refined, high-end touch to any interior.

Dial in your interior style by choosing between a bold chrome or stealthy black center outer housing.

Backed by Dakota Digital’s industry-leading 5-year warranty, the HND-9 delivers both performance and peace of mind. Built exclusively for VCM cruise control systems, this switch ensures precision compatibility—note that it is not designed for OEM or CRC/CRS systems.
